title: svelte-dialect
tagline: Tiny MessageFormat 2 i18n for Svelte 5 and SvelteKit.
lead: Runes instead of stores, namespaced keys, SSR locale negotiation, URL routing and typed message keys — in a library small enough to read in one sitting. This site is also the demo: it runs on the exact setup described here, prefix and all.
quickstart_lead: The core of it: create the dialect once and wire two hooks. The full path, from install to the first translated line, is on the Setup page.
counter_hint: Plural categories come from the locale, not from the library. Switch to Russian and the same message picks one / few / many.
rich: Built on {#mf2}MessageFormat 2{/mf2} — rich text lands as {#link}snippets{/link}, not string concatenation
card_setup_text: Install the package and wire it up, step by step, until the first translated line renders.
card_messages_text: Namespaced keys, plurals, numbers and dates, and what happens when a translation is missing or broken.
card_routing_text: /some/url for the default locale, /ru/some/url for everything else — cookie-remembered, prefix-overridable, the setup this site runs.
